{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' column to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Filter for completed orders
completed_orders = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Drop rows where revenue is invalid (NaN)
completed_orders = completed_orders.dropna(subset=['revenue'])

# Compute the mean revenue of completed orders
mean_revenue = completed_orders['revenue'].mean()

# Print the result
mean_revenue"}
